diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3.3 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: The second reading copied the nominal 'Operating Voltage 5V' spec-table value as the minimum. The modelled product's own page (Keyes/HW-493 KY-008, arduinomodules.info) states: '3.3 V boards. The KY-008 also works on 3.3 V boards like the ESP32, ESP8266 and Raspberry Pi Pico — wire it the same way and drive the signal from a GPIO pin. At 3.3 V the beam can be a little dimmer'. build-electronic-circuits.com (one of the second reading's own sources) gives 'Operating Voltage: 3-5 volts'. So 5 V is the nominal/maximum and 3.3 V is a valid minimum (dimmer beam), as the model says.
